To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the majority of the companies in the world are governed by boards of directors that are dominated by insiders and that the boards are not independent of management.
the most significant difference in the governance practices of the world's largest companies is in the area of board structure and composition.
the majority of companies around the world are committed to corporate governance and that the commitment to corporate governance is stronger in the United States than anywhere else.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the extent to which the board of directors is involved in and responsible for ensuring that the company takes responsibility for its actions and the extent to which it is accountable to its stakeholders.
the extent and manner in which companies have accepted the challenge of balancing their interests with those of their stakeholders and how they have responded to the challenge.
corporate governance in the sense of the relationship between a company and its stakeholders and how this is affected by business ethics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
corporate governance is a system by which a company is directed and controlled.
business ethics is the study of moral standards and moral values in business.

the corporate governance of a corporation is a process by which a corporation’s board of directors and management are held accountable to the corporation’s stakeholders, which include the shareholders, employees, clients, suppliers, local communities, creditors, and government.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

corporate governance is the system by which companies are directed and controlled, the system by which the owners of a company communicate their expectations to the management and by which the management and employees are held to account.
the corporate governance is an important tool for the management of the company.
business ethics and corporate governance have been the subject of intense debate in recent years and the debate is likely to continue for some years to come.
The main takeaway from our work is that
corporate governance is not a panacea for all ills.
the world is moving in the right direction.
corporate governance practices have a positive impact on firm performance and that the impact is greater in countries where corporate governance is less developed.
